title: Pure Kashtira
summary: Kashtira cards with generic Rank 7 and Rank 4 Xyz Monsters and staples. Kashtira Fenrir, Unicorn and Ogre summon themselves onto an empty board and search a Kashtira monster, Spell or Trap. Each time they attack, or the opponent activates a monster effect, they banish a card face-down from the field, the Extra Deck or the top of the Deck. Kashtira Riseheart banishes a Kashtira card from your Deck to banish three of theirs face-down and become Level 7. Kashtiratheosis summons a second Kashtira with another Attribute, so two Level 7s are on the field turn one. Kashtira Shangri-Ira locks a zone every time a card of theirs is banished face-down. Kashtira Arise-Heart is Forbidden. Kashtira Akstra needs Visas Starfrost and stays out. Riseheart and Kashtiratheosis limit the Extra Deck to Xyz Monsters for the turn.

exclude.Kashtira Akstra: Banishes Visas Starfrost, which the pure list doesn't play.

Summons itself; banishes their top three face-down and becomes Level 7.
Kashtira Ogre
Summons itself; searches a Kashtira Trap; banishes from their Deck.

Kashtira Birth
Normal Summons Level 7s without Tributing; revives a Kashtira from the GY or banishment.
Kashtiratheosis
Summons a Kashtira with another Attribute from the Deck; recovers a banished Kashtira.
Kashtira Overlap

Summons a Kashtira from the hand or banishment on either turn.

Makes each player banish down to one monster while a Kashtira Xyz is out.
